_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Shell control keys arrive in the terminal (ghostty), but the terminal toggle does not. Terminals render with ghostty. The browser is a 1280x900 desktop window. "Press K on X" means: focus X with an eval calling X.focus(), then press K (for example "Control+Shift+D" is the key "D" with modifiers Control+Shift, and "Control+Backquote" is the key "`" with modifier Control). "The message input" is data-testid "message-input"; "the terminal input" is the element with role "textbox" and accessible name exactly "Terminal input" that is visible; "focused" means it is document.activeElement. The conversation's directory holds keys.sh, a script that puts the terminal in raw mode, creates a file "ready", reads keys up to a "q" and writes their hex bytes to a file "received". Call "ready" says whether the file "ready" exists ("true" or "false"); call "received" returns the trimmed content of "received" ("" while it does not exist). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ID}}. 2. Fill the message input with "!bash keys.sh" and click the send button (data-testid "send-button"). 3. Call "ready" until it returns "true". 4. Press Control+Backquote on the message input: the terminal input should be focused. 5. Press Control+k on the terminal input: there must be no ".command-palette-overlay" (count 0). Press Control+b on the terminal input: still no ".command-palette-overlay" (count 0). 6. Press Control+Backquote on the terminal input: the message input should be focused. 7. Press Control+Backquote on the message input: the terminal input should be focused. 8. Press Control+Shift+D on the message input: ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. 9. Press Control+Backquote on the terminal input: ".terminal-panel" must not have the class "terminal-panel-minimized". 10. Focus the message input and press Escape: there should be no ".diff-viewer-overlay" (count 0). 11. Press "q" on the terminal input. 12. Call "received" until it returns exactly "0b 02" (Control+k and Control+b reached the shell; the toggle presses did not).
